📌About this video:
IBPS SO IT Officer Exam Analysis 2026 for Shift 1 and Shift 2—expected cut off, good attempts, questions asked, score calculation, expected result timeline and complete Mains preparation roadmap.

The IBPS SO IT Officer Prelims 2026 was conducted on 29 August 2026 under CRP SPL-XVI. In this evidence-based analysis, Yash Jain Sir explains the revised exam pattern, section-wise difficulty, reported topics, Professional Knowledge questions, expected score range and the right preparation strategy after Prelims.

📌 In this video:
✅ IBPS SO IT Officer Shift 1 complete analysis
✅ IBPS SO IT Officer Shift 2 analysis
✅ English, Reasoning, Quant and Professional Knowledge review
✅ Reported IT questions and important concepts

✅ Expected cut off out of 125 marks
✅ Negative-marking-based score calculation
✅ IBPS SO Prelims expected result timeline
✅ Who should immediately start Mains preparation?
✅ Who should follow a dual Prelims + Mains strategy?
✅ High-priority Professional Knowledge topics for Mains
✅ Two-month IBPS SO IT Officer Mains roadmap
✅ Latest revised 376 IT Officer vacancies

The revised Prelims contained 100 questions for 125 marks in 80 minutes. Professional Knowledge carried 50 marks, making PK accuracy more important than total attempts alone.

⚠️ Expected Cut Off Disclaimer:
Our provisional planning range is 65–72 marks out of 125. This is an evidence-based estimate with limited confidence—not the official IBPS cutoff or a guaranteed selection score. Good attempts are not equal to marks because PK questions carry double weight and also have a higher negative penalty.

📅 Result and Mains Update:
The exact Prelims result date has not been officially announced. The tentative result window is September/October 2026. IBPS SO Mains is scheduled for 1 November 2026.

Comment your shift, section-wise attempts, estimated wrong answers and one Professional Knowledge concept you remember.

IBPS SO IT Officer 2026 Prelims is on 29 August 2026. With only the final 3 days remaining, this video gives you an exact last-minute preparation strategy covering the new exam pattern, Professional Knowledge, target score, cutoff discussion, important topics, mock-test strategy and the complete 26–28 August study plan.

🔥 IBPS SO IT Officer 2026 New Prelims Pattern
English: 25 Questions | 25 Marks | 20 Minutes
Reasoning: 25 Questions | 25 Marks | 20 Minutes
Quantitative Aptitude: 25 Questions | 25 Marks | 20 Minutes
Professional Knowledge: 25 Questions | 50 Marks | 20 Minutes

Total: 100 Questions | 125 Marks | 80 Minutes

Professional Knowledge alone carries 50 marks, making technical preparation extremely important in the new pattern.

🎯 High-Priority Professional Knowledge Topics:
DBMS + SQL: Keys, Normalization, Joins, Transactions, ACID
Operating Systems: Process, Scheduling, Memory, Deadlock
Computer Networks: OSI, TCP/IP, Protocols, IP, Security
DSA: Stack, Queue, Tree, Graph, Sorting

These are the highest-priority technical areas recommended for the final revision window.

📅 FINAL 3-DAY PLAN:

26 August:
Diagnostic mocks + identify weak areas + repair mistakes

27 August:
Full exam simulation + serious mock analysis + final error notebook

28 August:
No heavy new topics. Revise formulas, short notes, mock mistakes and keep confidence stable.

29 August:
IBPS SO IT Officer Prelims 2026

The strategy focuses on quality mock analysis rather than attempting random tests without reviewing mistakes.

Prepare smart, analyse every mock and give maximum priority to Professional Knowledge in these final days.
